## About
Color Coat Auto Body and Repair is a neighborhood shop on Jones Road in Houston. We do body repair and refinishing, mechanical service and vehicle emissions inspections, so you can bring your car to one place for most of what it needs.
On the body side, that means collision repair, color matching, frame repair, fiberglass work, restoration, spoilers and custom paint, using PPG basecoat and clearcoat systems. On the mechanical side, we handle everything from oil changes to full engine rebuilds.
Customers mention Mr. Park explaining things clearly and Sam looking out for them after accidents. We're rated 4.1 from 95 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto body repair and refinishing: Collision repair, color matching, frame repair, fiberglass work, restoration, spoilers and custom paint.
- Mechanical service and repair: Oil changes through full engine rebuilds, including brake jobs, tune ups, engine diagnostics, air conditioning, suspension and cooling system work.
- Vehicle emissions inspection: Get your emissions inspection done here, with fast service and minimal waiting so you can get back on the road.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Give us a call to set up a free estimate.

Q: What if I need a tow or a rental car?
A: In case of an emergency, call 281-300-8990 for towing, wrecker service or rental vehicle assistance.
